annotations.title: Create or change through the DCAST API

description: Call one documented POST, PUT or PATCH operation of the DCAST Partner API v1 (https://api.dcast.pro/api/v1, documented at https://dcast.pro/docs, OpenAPI document https://api.dcast.pro/api/v1/docs/openapi.json): creates, changes, or runs a command such as start, stop or end. Also a GET that the API marks as writing (x-dcast-side-effect, for example GET /me/custom-domain/nameservers creates the Cloudflare zone, GET /me/custom-domain/verify stores the verdict). The arguments are checked against the operation's contract first; a mismatch is answered with the exact problems and howToFix and NOTHING is sent. Runs with the connected user's own access: permission, plan limits and rate limits are the API's. Act only on what the user asked. GET operations go to dcast_read_operation, DELETE to dcast_delete_operation. Money, key minting, team access, uploads and viewer-side actions are not available.
